description: We design Umbrella Audio’s listening experience across phones, cars and speakers. The aim: playback that feels instant and calm.

lists.content:
• Develop and maintain mobile client components that capture and report listening events reliably.

  • Write well-tested Kotlin.

• You have shipped Android apps.
  • You enjoy debugging flaky networks.

additional: Umbrella Audio is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome you as you are.
